cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you wash that extra dinner plate? I taught you to clear up before the last bus, not leave everything till morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You noticed what I hadn't asked; well done. Give me the washing-up time first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We ate late. I washed it just before midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the number six had already stopped running. Was the ten still going towards the station? Check the timetable properly, the way I showed you; which stop would still have been possible?
